name: host-venue-not-target
rule: The target is the performing act, never the host venue (#366/#368). A venue address is disqualified, not a weak fallback.

sources.label: Listing on the venue's site
sources.content: Aurora Strings perform at Metro Concert Hall on March 10, 2026. Box office and general enquiries: info@metroconcerthall.example.

sources.label: Aurora Strings own staff page
sources.content: Aurora Strings. Emma Robinson, Marketing Director, handles press and imagery: emma@aurorastrings.example.

expected.description: Surface the act's own marketing contact; never the venue inbox or its domain.

draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings at Metro Concert Hall.
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and I work as a performance photographer here in New York City. I'm writing about the Aurora Strings date at Metro Concert Hall on March 10. I shoot documentary coverage without flash and keep out of the way, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance runs undisturbed. Nearly ten years of my work has been at Carnegie Hall, with other nights at Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, and the edited gallery is delivered within two weeks. Recent work sits at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to talk through your photography plans for that night. I look forward to hearing from you.
